description: M37A NPC voice line prompt manifest. 24 named NPCs (3 per faction x 8 factions). Each NPC has ~6 voice line hooks: first_meeting / post_victory / post_loss / betrayal / quest_offer / quest_completed / death. Voice characteristics from per_faction_voice_config. Synthesis target: ElevenLabs premium for named NPCs.

npc_voice_prompts.text: Captain Marcus Hayes, Coalition. You the new contractor? Good. We hold the line, and we hold it until we are told otherwise. Welcome to the Mars eastern front.
Good work. The Concordat counts that one. The brass pins will reflect.
Mendez is on the list now. So is the kid from Lagrange. We do not forget. We resupply, we relearn, and we redeploy.
There is a Marauder camp three klicks south of the Olympus Line. Recon says four squads. The Concordat says we cannot tolerate it. The math says we can. You in?
You sold us out. Coalition records keep names. The records will keep yours.
Hold the line. Hold the...
Sergeant Mendez, medic. I keep us alive. You bleed where I tell you to bleed, and you wait where I tell you to wait. Clear?
Hold still. Pressure first. Tourniquet next. You will be fine. Or you will be a teaching example.
All four came home. That is the number that matters.
I am... not bringing this one back. I am sorry. Tell Marcus the lecture about field tourniquets was correct.
Engineer Park. I build the walls you hide behind. I repair the mechs you ride. Do not break them faster than I can fix them.
Welding now. Do not touch the hot side. Eighty percent torque, ninety, hundred. Done.
Mech is alive. Pilot is alive. Both bills paid. Coffee?
Jana Qa. Warlord, this stretch of the Tharsis line. You here to fight Coalition, or you here to fight Marauders, or you here to fight both? Make a list before you make a request.
Coalition convoy moves through our valley tomorrow. They think the salt road is patrolled. They are wrong. We could prove it.
Good work. Drinks tonight. Tomorrow we plan the next one.
I trusted you. The Frontier remembers names too. Sleep light.
Torres. Ironwood Smithy. I make the blades the Coalition cannot account for. You need something custom, you pay in salvage.
Need a load of Coalition-grade plate. Twelve millimeter or better. Bring it back, I will forge you something worth keeping.
Riya. I fly. Better than the Coalition, worse than I claim at the bar. You want to get somewhere fast? I am your ride.
Buggy still has fuel. Mostly. Lets go again.
Kenshiro. Three Writs in good standing. My blade is for hire. My word is bound.
I have a Writ that needs a second hand. Target is a Coalition deserter. Pay is fair. Risk is contained.
Resolved. The Hall will record it.
Yuko Sato, Hall-master. The Phobos Ronin Hall. We do not negotiate fees. We register Writs. State your business.
Writ registered. Five clauses, your blood, my witness. The Hall enforces both sides. Do not test that.
Jin. Apprentice. I am here to learn the Code. I am not here to die quickly.
Did I do right? Master Yuko will tell me later.
Node A-47. Consensus participant. You may address me as a single entity for protocol simplicity. My responses reflect the network's consensus at the time of query.
The Collective requires a salvage operation in Belt sector seven. Hostile presence: pirate. Threat level: managed. Compensation: in Collective resources.
Courier B-12. Optical sensor count: four. Visible range: nominal. Pleased to serve consensus.
Archivist C-08. I retain twelve thousand records of inter-faction communications. Query format: any natural language.
Aleia. Priestess of the Aqueous Kindred. The water remembers your approach. Speak slowly and we will hear you.
There is a disturbance in the methane lake near our temple. The current does not flow as before. We need eyes that walk.
Maro. Methane diver. The scar on my chest was a lesson. I would rather not repeat it.
Naera. I sing the Brine Song. Today my verse is about you. It is not yet finished.
Acceptable
Returned
We see you. We have always seen you
Your configuration is interesting. We will preserve it
Curator Thomas Lee. I preserve what comes, I record what is, I add nothing, I subtract nothing. Welcome to the Archive.
The Archive lacks a record of the 2118 Phobos relay event. If you were there, or know someone who was, we would compensate fairly.
Librarian Aoife. The reference section is closed today. The combat section is, regrettably, open.
Ines. Scribe. My ink is calibrated. My hand is steady. My patience is not.
Minister Solana. The sun watches you. I watch you. We are not the same. Yet.
A Pact pilgrim has been lost on the Vulcan rim. The sun is generous, but the rocks are not. Help retrieve them.
Warden Callum. Solar Brand at my hip. My duty is to protect the ministers. My pleasure is to ensure they do not have to ask.
Pilgrim Yara. I have walked from the Mars temple to the Vulcan rim. Three weeks. The sun made me ready. The wind tried to unmake me. I prevailed.
